线上会议专项 · 第 07 课

确认决定、负责人和时间

在会议结束前复述决定，确认责任人与期限，并澄清任务之间的依赖关系。

02 / 05

分段听懂

情节 01

分配任务

DDacey

Before we , let's confirm the next steps. We've agreed to run the customer training next Thursday and keep the session to thirty minutes. The remaining question is who checks the materials before we send them.

结束之前，我们确认一下接下来的步骤。我们已经同意下周四进行客户培训，把时长控制在三十分钟。剩下的问题是：发送前由谁检查材料。

TTim

I'll take care of the demo slides. I can check the setup steps against the current product and mark anything that needs changing. Would Wednesday afternoon give you enough time to make the edits?

演示幻灯片由我负责。我可以对照当前产品检查设置步骤，标出需要修改的地方。周三下午给你，来得及修改吗？

DDacey

Yes, if I receive your comments by three. I'll make the changes that evening and send the on Thursday morning. I'll also handle the invitation and the list of people joining the session.

可以，只要三点前收到你的意见。我会当天晚上修改，周四上午发送最终文件。邀请和参会名单也由我负责。

情节 02

核对时间

TTim

Just to confirm, you're sending the slides to the customer this Thursday, not on the training day? I want to make sure I'm checking the right deadline. That gives them a week to look through the material.

确认一下，你是这周四给客户发幻灯片，不是培训当天发，对吗？我想确保我理解的截止时间是对的。这样他们有一周时间看材料。

DDacey

That's right. The training is next Thursday, but the materials go out this week. There's one we should check: the screenshots need approval before they go into the final slides.

没错。培训在下周四，但材料这周发送。有一个依赖事项需要确认：截图必须获批后才能放进最终幻灯片。

情节 03

处理依赖

TTim

I'll follow up on the screenshots today. If they're approved before Wednesday, I'll include them in my review. If not, I'll mark those pages clearly so you don't accidentally send unapproved images to the customer.

我今天会跟进截图。如果周三前获批，我会一起检查。否则我会明确标注那些页面，免得你不小心把未获批的图片发给客户。

DDacey

If approval is still , we'll use the text instructions instead. I'd rather send a complete, accurate guide than hold everything for two screenshots. I'll explain that change in the email.

如果还在等审批，我们就改用文字说明。比起为了两张截图拖住所有内容，我更希望发出一份完整、准确的指南。我会在邮件里说明这个调整。

TTim

Agreed. Could you put the in the shared notes? Please include the and deadline for each one. That saves everyone searching through the recording.

同意。你能把行动项写进共享纪要吗？请写上每一项的负责人和截止时间。这样大家就不用在录像里找了。

情节 04

复述行动项

DDacey

I'll update the notes right after this call. So, you review the slides by Wednesday at three; I edit them and send everything on Thursday morning. You'll also check the screenshot approval today.

通话结束后我就更新纪要。也就是说，你周三三点前检查幻灯片；我修改，并在周四上午把所有内容发出。你今天还会确认截图审批。

TTim

Yes, that matches my understanding. If anything puts the review deadline at risk, I'll message you before Wednesday rather than waiting until the file is due.

对，和我的理解一致。如果有事情可能影响检查期限，我会在周三之前给你发消息，而不是等到文件该交的时候。
